name: Kentucky
source: gun-policy Season 3 Stage 5, Kentucky session A hand-over (ky/HANDOVER-A.md part 7), 2026-11-14
sessions: Annual regular sessions; bills are numbered afresh each session (e.g. 25RS SB 75 = 2025 regular session). House 100 seats, Senate 38.
bill_data: LegiScan bulk datasets are on disk; never re-pull a dataset. LegiScan per-bill calls only.
Bill texts fetch direct from apps.legislature.ky.gov (no LegiScan call needed); old www.lrc.ky.gov links do not answer, but the same path on apps.legislature.ky.gov works.

votes.floor_rule: Floor votes are 'House: Third Reading RCS# n' and 'Senate: Third Reading RSN# n', often followed by the version voted on (e.g. 'W/scs1', 'W/FINAL fccr'). Keep Third Reading, Veto Override and a resolution's own Adopt; drop floor-amendment votes (Adopt HFA/SFA), Suspend the Rules, Co-Sponsor, For Consent, Consider Motion and Table.
gaps: LegiScan labels 602 House roll calls 'Veto Override'; many are plain passage votes. Check the bill's history before reading one as an override.

texts.marks: PDFs read as pdftotext -layout. Every line starts with a line number that is not part of the law. Struck (deleted) words come out inside square brackets; rewrite them to [-struck-] before a quote check. Added words are underlined in the PDF and the underline is lost in the text, so added words read as plain words beside the struck ones. A whole new section is headed 'SECTION n. A NEW SECTION OF KRS CHAPTER nnn IS CREATED TO READ AS FOLLOWS:' (every word new); an amended section is headed 'Section n. KRS nnn.nnn is amended to read as follows:'.
texts.note: Bill PDFs: https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/<yy>RS/<bill>/bill.pdf. Bill page: https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/record/<yy>rs/<bill>.html. Because underlines are lost, a reprinted section cannot show which unbracketed words are new; quotes that cross a page break (footer, line numbers restart) or join a lead-in to its lettered item will not match verbatim. apps.legislature.ky.gov has no robots.txt (404); bill pages, bill PDFs and roll-call PDFs (record/<yy>rs/<bill>/vote_history.pdf) return 200 (2026-11-14).

reader_access.www.lrc.ky.gov: blocked: host does not answer (2026-11-14); use the same path on apps.legislature.ky.gov

search_note: Roll-call PDFs (vote_history.pdf) list each chamber's RCS#/RSN#, the tally and member names by surname.
bill_table_note: Texts mark deleted words as [-struck-] (after the bracket rewrite); added words are not marked. Never read [- -] text as something the bill does, except as what it removes. In a reprinted section, do not assume an unbracketed word is new.
quirks: Struck words are bracketed and added words lose their underline in extracted text.
Many House roll calls are labelled 'Veto Override' in LegiScan though they are passage votes.
